description: Validate a VAT number and get the registered business name and address. EU numbers via the official VIES service, UK numbers via HMRC. Use for invoicing, supplier onboarding, tax and KYB checks. Accepts e.g. IE6388047V, DE811234567, GB553557881. (cost: 2 credits)

country.description: string: 2-letter country code if not already on the number

vat.description: string, required: VAT number, with or without the country prefix

name: vat_check
